title: Global completeness of one-sorted definedness-free matching logic
abstract: Formalizes the one-sorted case of Chen and Roșu's global-completeness argument and independently discharges its local-completeness oracle by mechanizing the canonical-model construction from their 2019 Matching μ-Logic technical report (Theorem 73, Lemmas 80–81, and strong local completeness Theorem 83). The resulting theorem supplies both local completeness and soundness for countably infinite variable types.

informal.MatchingLogic.locality: For a backward-closed subset of a matching-logic model, two valuations that agree inside the subset and both stay outside it otherwise give identical denotations after restriction to that subset.
informal.MatchingLogic.two_copies: The double-cover model over a nonempty backward-closed proper subset has exactly the denotation predicted by each of its two projections back to the original model.
informal.MatchingLogic.semantic_localization: For a closed theory and closed conclusion, global semantic consequence is equivalent to local consequence from the localized theory.
informal.MatchingLogic.strongLocalCompleteness: One-sorted basic matching logic has strong local completeness over an arbitrary one-sorted finitary signature when the element-variable type is countably infinite.
informal.MatchingLogic.global_completeness_entryI: For a one-sorted finitary signature, closed premises and conclusion, and a countably infinite element-variable type, global semantic consequence is equivalent to derivability, with both soundness and local completeness discharged.
